Customs Clearance & International Logistics

At Aqkrih International Ltd., we make international trade simpler, faster, and more reliable through professional customs clearance and logistics solutions. Our experienced team supports clients throughout the import and export process, ensuring accurate documentation, proper HS code classification, regulatory compliance, customs coordination, and timely cargo clearance. From shipment preparation and customs formalities to duty assessment and final delivery coordination, we provide end-to-end support tailored to each customer's requirements. With a strong focus on compliance, transparency, efficiency, and customer satisfaction, Aqkrih International Ltd. is committed to making every international shipment move smoothly and efficiently.

About Us

A concern of the AKIJ Group, built on eight decades of industrial trust.

Aqkrih International Ltd. is a Customs House Agent (CHA) operating as a concern of Akij Logistics Ltd. and Akij Resources Ltd., under the AKIJ Group — a conglomerate established in the early 1940s. We represent the group's expansion into freight forwarding, airline representation, and cargo handling, upholding a legacy of quality, innovation and service excellence across Bangladesh's industrial and service sectors.

We provide unparalleled customs clearing and forwarding (C&F) service for both outbound and inbound shipments — moving through Sea, Air and Land — with dedicated offices stationed at all the major ports of Bangladesh.

"To become the benchmark of customer choice in the logistics industry through reliability, cost efficiency, and seamless service."

Operations

Dedicated space, at every stage of clearance.

From cargo village bays to container yards, our facilities are built to keep shipments moving without delay.

01 · DAC CARGO VILLAGE

Dedicated Bay Dispatch

A dedicated space and bay at the Dhaka Airport Cargo Village for fast dispatching of air cargo.

02 · PALLETIZATION

ULD Build-Up

Cargo palletization and build-up pallets handed over to airlines, with ULDs handed to aircraft on schedule.

03 · LCL

Consolidation Space

A dedicated space for LCL (Less than Container Load) consolidation, keeping mixed shipments organized.

04 · CONTAINER YARD

Container Storage & Transport

Dedicated container storage plus our own transportation fleet for laden and stuffed container movement.
